personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for B2B Corporate Android)
personality_one_liner: A highly functional, crisp, and trustworthy corporate CRM that prioritizes data readability and straightforward navigation over decorative flair.

spacing.rule: Generous padding inside cards, clear vertical rhythm. No cramped lists.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism. User strictly prohibited it.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point for corporate users.

states.error: Inline text below inputs in #EF4444. Toast for Network Error.

screens.layout: Vertical stack centered. MedLabs text logo at top. Username and Password inputs stacked (labels above). Full-width #1F5297 primary button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide at-a-glance KPI and charts for customer status.

states.error: Card showing 'Failed to load dashboard' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top: 2 KPI Cards side-by-side or stacked (Status Customer, Status Bad Debt). Middle: 3 Donut Charts stacked vertically inside white cards. Legend strictly BELOW chart using format: dot Label / XXX Customer • XX.X%. Use brand colors (+ success/error) for chart slices.

screens.name: Customers
screens.purpose: List all customers with searchable interface.
screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top. FlatList of customer cards. Each card displays Customer Name, Code, Segment, Area, Status (colored badge). Tidy icon-caption spacing. Read-only.

screens.name: Customer Detail
screens.purpose: Show comprehensive data and location for a specific customer.

states.error: Customer Not Found illustration with back button.

screens.layout: Scrollable. Header with Name & Code. Data listed cleanly in key-value rows. Bottom section: Map View taking 200px height. Marker at lat/long. Button below map: 'Open in Google Maps'. Fallback if no coords: centered text 'Lokasi customer belum tersedia.' in place of map.

screens.name: About
screens.layout: Centered layout. App name bold. Tagline 'Customer Data & Analytics'. App Info list (Version, Developer, Platform). Minimal footer text fixed at bottom: '© 2026 MedLabs'.

login_hero.alt: Modern corporate building representing MedLabs headquarters

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RULE: LIGHT MODE ONLY. Do not configure dark mode options.
STRICT RULE: NO GLASSMORPHISM, NO GRADIENTS. Do not use expo-blur. Use solid colors and simple shadow tier 1 for elevation.
STRICT RULE: The About page footer must be minimal, exactly '© 2026 MedLabs'.
STRICT RULE: For the 3 Donut Charts on the Dashboard, the legend MUST be placed BELOW the chart, never beside it. Use format: colored dot ● Label / XXX Customer • XX.X%.
STRICT RULE: If a customer detail has no coordinates, hide the map and show the text 'Lokasi customer belum tersedia.' exactly.
Use '#1F5297' for the Drawer Header and active states. Use '#EE8C28' for secondary actions, warning states, or specific data points in charts.
Data components (KPIs, Lists, Details) must be framed in simple white cards (surfaceSecondary) with rounded corners (md radius) and a subtle shadow (tier 1).
Ensure tidy spacing between icons and captions throughout the app, as requested.
